answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The marble of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the haven of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the onyx re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
